blocks.text: 26-darsda could ni can ning o'tgan zamoni sifatida ko'rdik: I **could** swim when I was six. Lekin could juda ko'p hollarda **hozir va kelajak** haqida ham ishlatiladi. Bunda u o'tmishni emas, «yumshoqroq», «noaniqroq» imkoniyatni bildiradi: taklif (We could ...), ehtimol (It could rain), xayoliy imkoniyat (I could ...). O'tmishdagi amalga oshmagan imkoniyat uchun esa **could have + V3** ishlatiladi — o'zbekchadagi «-sa bo'lardi», «-ishi mumkin edi». Bu darsda shu to'rt ma'noni ajratamiz.

**could** bilan muloyim taklif yoki variant aytiladi: We **could** go to Charvak on Sunday — Yakshanba kuni Chorvoqqa borsak bo'ladi. Bu «Let's ...» dan yumshoqroq: so'zlovchi buyurmaydi, faqat bir variantni o'rtaga tashlaydi. You **could** ... — maslahat-variant: «...sang bo'ladi». O'zbekchada «-sak bo'ladi», «-sang bo'ladi», «-sak-chi?» ga to'g'ri keladi. **can** bilan ham aytish mumkin (We can go...), lekin could ko'proq «variantlardan biri» ohangini beradi.

items.text: We **could have** a picnic by the river on Sunday.
items.translation: Yakshanba kuni daryo bo'yida **piknik qilsak bo'ladi**.

items.text: You **could try** the new Korean café near the station.
items.translation: Vokzal yonidagi yangi koreys kafesini **sinab ko'rsang bo'ladi**.

items.text: What **could** we **buy** Grandma for her birthday?

blocks.text: **could** = «...ishi mumkin»: hozir yoki kelajakdagi **muayyan** holat haqida taxmin. It **could** rain later — Keyinroq yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin; The story **could** be true — Hikoya rost bo'lishi mumkin. Bu ma'noda could ≈ might / may (→ 29-dars). Ehtiyot bo'ling: **can** bu yerda boshqacha — u **umumiy** imkoniyatni, ya'ni «shunday bo'lib turadi» degan faktni bildiradi. Muayyan holat haqidagi taxmin uchun can ishlatilmaydi.

rows: The roads **can be** icy in January.

blocks.text: 3. Xayoliy imkoniyat: I could ... / I couldn't ...

could ba'zan «imkon bo'lsa, qila olardim» degan **xayoliy** ma'noni beradi: I'm so hungry I **could eat** a whole lamb — Shunchalik ochmanki, butun bir qo'yni yeya olardim. Inkori **couldn't** — «...olmasdim»: I **couldn't live** in a big noisy city — Katta shovqinli shaharda yashay olmasdim. Bu yerda gap o'tmish haqida emas, xayoldagi holat haqida. Xayoliy shart gaplar (if I had ...) batafsil — 38–40-darslarda.
could have done — imkon bor edi, lekin bo'lmadi

**could have + V3** — o'tmishda biror narsa **mumkin edi**, lekin amalga **oshmadi**. O'zbekchada «-sa bo'lardi», «-ishi mumkin edi»: Why did you take a taxi? You **could have walked** — Nega taksiga o'tirding? Piyoda borsang bo'lardi. Xavfli holat haqida ham: You **could have fallen** — Yiqilib tushishing mumkin edi (lekin yiqilmading). could dan keyin doim **have** (has emas) va **V3** keladi — bu shakl shaxsga qarab o'zgarmaydi.

rows: We **could go** to the cinema tonight.
We **could have gone** to the cinema last night.
You **could have asked** Madina for help!
It **could have rained**, but luckily it didn't.

items.text: Why did you buy a new printer? You **could have used** mine.
items.translation: Nega yangi printer olding? Menikidan **foydalansang bo'lardi**.

items.text: Dilnoza **could have won**, but she fell near the finish line.
items.translation: Dilnoza **g'olib bo'lishi mumkin edi**, lekin marraga yaqin yiqilib tushdi.

items.text: The fire **could have destroyed** the whole building.
items.translation: Yong'in butun binoni **vayron qilishi mumkin edi**.

blocks.text: could have done ko'pincha **gina, ta'na** ohangida aytiladi: You **could have told** me! — Aytsang bo'lardi-ku! O'zbekchadagi «-sang bo'lardi-ku» ga aynan mos. Ohang yumshoq bo'lsa — shunchaki boy berilgan imkoniyat: We **could have stayed** longer — Ko'proq qolsak ham bo'lardi.

**couldn't have + V3** — o'tmishda biror narsa **imkonsiz** edi: We **couldn't have finished** without you — Sizsiz tugata olmagan bo'lardik. Maqtov va minnatdorlikda ko'p uchraydi: The day **couldn't have been** better — Kun bundan yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin emasdi (ya'ni, a'lo o'tdi). Mantiqiy xulosa ma'nosidagi «bo'lishi mumkin emas» (He couldn't have seen me) — 28-darsda.

items.text: We **couldn't have done** it without you.

items.translation: To'y bundan yaxshi **o'tishi mumkin emas edi**.

items.text: Honestly, I **couldn't have managed** the move alone.
items.translation: Rostini aytsam, ko'chishni yolg'iz **eplay olmagan bo'lardim**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «You could came» / «could to come» → You **could have come**; «She could has done» → could **have** (doim have); «The road can be icy tonight» → **could be** (muayyan holat); «I could pass the test yesterday» (bitta muvaffaqiyat) → I **was able to** pass (→ 26-dars); «Aytsangiz bo'lardi» ni har doim could have deb tarjima qilish: imkon bor edi → **could have told**; to'g'ri ish shu edi, qattiq ta'na → **should have told** (→ 33-dars).

Formulani yodlang: **could have + V3** = «-sa bo'lardi / -ishi mumkin edi» — o'tmishda mumkin edi, lekin bo'lmadi. **couldn't have + V3** = «-a olmagan bo'lardi / -ishi mumkin emas edi» — o'tmishda imkonsiz edi.

examples.title: Suggestions: **We could** ..., **You could** ...
examples.description: Muloyim taklif yoki variant — could + fe'l. O'zbekcha «-sak bo'ladi», «-sang bo'ladi».

sentences.text: We **could go** to Charvak at the weekend if the weather's nice.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo yaxshi bo'lsa, dam olish kunlari Chorvoqqa **borsak bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: If you're bored, you **could help** me clean the garage.
sentences.translation: Zerikkan bo'lsang, garajni tozalashga **yordam bersang bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: What shall we cook tonight? — We **could make** manti; we've got everything.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun nima pishiramiz? — Manti **qilsak bo'ladi**, hamma narsa bor.

sentences.text: You **could ask** Jasur — he knows a lot about computers.
sentences.translation: Jasurdan **so'rasang bo'ladi** — u kompyuterlarni yaxshi biladi.

sentences.text: Instead of flying, you **could take** the night train to Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Samolyot o'rniga Buxoroga tungi poyezdda **borsangiz ham bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: If the hotel is full, they **could stay** with my aunt for a few nights.
sentences.translation: Agar mehmonxona to'la bo'lsa, ular bir necha kun xolamnikida **qolishsa bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Your CV is fine, but you **could add** a section about your volunteer work.
sentences.translation: Rezyumeing yaxshi, lekin ko'ngillilik faoliyating haqida bo'lim **qo'shsang bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Where **could** we **meet** that's convenient for both of us?
sentences.translation: Ikkalamizga ham qulay bo'lgan qayerda **uchrashsak bo'ladi**?

sentences.text: Sarah **could apply** for a scholarship — her grades are excellent.
sentences.translation: Sara stipendiyaga **hujjat topshirsa bo'ladi** — baholari a'lo.

sentences.text: Rather than arguing by email, maybe the two teams **could discuss** it face to face.
sentences.translation: Elektron pochtada tortishgandan ko'ra, ikki jamoa buni yuzma-yuz **muhokama qilsa bo'lar**.

examples.title: Possibility now or later: **It could** ...
examples.description: Hozir yoki kelajakdagi muayyan holat haqida taxmin — could + fe'l, «...ishi mumkin».

sentences.text: Take a jacket — it **could get** cold after sunset.
sentences.translation: Kurtka ol — quyosh botgandan keyin **sovib ketishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Don't throw that letter away; it **could be** important.
sentences.translation: U xatni tashlab yuborma; **muhim bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The story sounds strange, but it **could be** true.
sentences.translation: Hikoya g'alati eshitiladi, lekin **rost bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Where's Aziz? — I'm not sure. He **could be** at the gym.
sentences.translation: Aziz qayerda? — Bilmadim. **Sport zalida bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Prices **could rise** again next year if the crisis continues.
sentences.translation: Inqiroz davom etsa, kelasi yil narxlar yana **oshishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Be careful with that knife — you **could cut** yourself.
sentences.translation: U pichoq bilan ehtiyot bo'l — qo'lingni **kesib olishing mumkin**.

sentences.text: The new vaccine **could save** thousands of lives every year.
sentences.translation: Yangi vaksina har yili minglab hayotni **saqlab qolishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: That noise **could be** the neighbours' washing machine, not our pipes.
sentences.translation: Bu shovqin bizning quvurlarimiz emas, qo'shnilarning kir yuvish mashinasi **bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The meeting **could go** on for hours, so don't wait for me for dinner.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish soatlab **cho'zilishi mumkin**, shuning uchun kechki ovqatga meni kutmang.

sentences.text: Kate's phone is off, so she **could** still **be** on the plane.
sentences.translation: Keytning telefoni o'chiq, demak u hali samolyotda **bo'lishi mumkin**.

examples.title: **can** or **could**? In general or this time
examples.description: Juft-juft: can — umumiy imkoniyat, «bo'lib turadi»; could — muayyan holat haqida taxmin, «bo'lishi mumkin».

sentences.text: The road over the pass **can be** dangerous in winter.
sentences.translation: Dovondagi yo'l qishda **xavfli bo'lib turadi**.

sentences.text: Drive slowly tonight — the road over the pass **could be** icy.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechasi sekin hayda — dovondagi yo'l **muz bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Children **can be** very cruel to each other at school.
sentences.translation: Maktabda bolalar bir-biriga ba'zan juda **shafqatsiz bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Madina hasn't phoned — she **could be** angry with me.
sentences.translation: Madina qo'ng'iroq qilmadi — mendan **xafa bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Learning a language **can take** years, but it's worth it.
sentences.translation: Til o'rganish ba'zan **yillab davom etadi**, lekin bunga arziydi.

sentences.text: This repair **could take** a week, depending on the parts.
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot qismlarga qarab, bu ta'mir bir hafta **cho'zilishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: In Bukhara the summer heat **can reach** 45 degrees.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda yozgi issiq 45 darajaga **yetib turadi**.

sentences.text: It **could reach** 40 degrees tomorrow, according to the forecast.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumotiga ko'ra, ertaga harorat 40 darajaga **yetishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Online reviews **can be** misleading, so read them carefully.
sentences.translation: Onlayn sharhlar ba'zan **chalg'itadi**, shuning uchun ularni diqqat bilan o'qing.

sentences.text: This review **could be** fake — it's far too positive.
sentences.translation: Bu sharh **soxta bo'lishi mumkin** — juda ham maqtovli.

examples.title: Imagined: **I could** ... / **I couldn't** ...
examples.description: Xayoliy imkoniyat: «-a olardim», «-a olmasdim». Gap o'tmish haqida emas, xayoldagi holat haqida.

sentences.text: I'm so tired I **could sleep** for a whole day.
sentences.translation: Shunchalik charchadimki, bir kun bo'yi **uxlay olardim**.

sentences.text: Tom loves this city; he **could live** here forever.
sentences.translation: Tom bu shaharni yaxshi ko'radi; bu yerda abadiy **yashay olardi**.

sentences.text: I **couldn't work** in an office without windows; I need daylight.
sentences.translation: Derazasiz ofisda **ishlay olmasdim**; menga kunduzgi yorug'lik kerak.

sentences.text: This soup is delicious — I **could eat** three bowls of it!
sentences.translation: Bu sho'rva juda mazali — uch kosa **yeya olardim**!

sentences.text: Madina **couldn't live** without her phone, even for a day.
sentences.translation: Madina telefonsiz bir kun ham **yashay olmasdi**.

sentences.text: The view from here is amazing; I **could sit** and look at it for hours.
sentences.translation: Bu yerdan manzara ajoyib; soatlab o'tirib unga **tikilib tura olardim**.

sentences.text: Our boss **couldn't manage** the team without Sarah's help.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'imiz Saraning yordamisiz jamoani **boshqara olmasdi**.

sentences.text: James is so talented that he **could be** a professional singer.
sentences.translation: Jeyms shunchalik iqtidorliki, professional qo'shiqchi **bo'la olardi**.

sentences.text: I **couldn't do** your job; dealing with angry customers all day is too stressful.
sentences.translation: Sening ishingni **qila olmasdim**; kun bo'yi jahldor mijozlar bilan ishlash juda asabiy.

sentences.text: With a bit more practice, Jasur **could win** the national championship.
sentences.translation: Biroz ko'proq mashq qilsa, Jasur respublika chempionatida **g'olib bo'la olardi**.

examples.title: **could have done**: possible, but it didn't happen
examples.description: O'tmishda imkon bor edi, lekin amalga oshmadi — could have + V3. O'zbekcha «-sa bo'lardi», «-ishi mumkin edi»; ko'pincha ta'na ohangida.

sentences.text: Why did you take a taxi? You **could have walked** — it's only ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Nega taksiga o'tirding? Piyoda **borsang bo'lardi** — atigi o'n daqiqa-ku.

sentences.text: Honestly, we **could have gone** to the concert, but we were too lazy to get dressed.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, konsertga **borsak bo'lardi**, lekin kiyinishga erindik.

sentences.text: Aziz **could have become** a footballer, but he chose medicine instead.
sentences.translation: Aziz futbolchi **bo'lishi mumkin edi**, lekin uning o'rniga tibbiyotni tanladi.

sentences.text: You **could have told** me you were in Tashkent! We haven't seen each other for years.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda ekaningni **aytsang bo'lardi**-ku! Necha yildan beri ko'rishmadik.

sentences.text: The accident **could have been** much worse — luckily nobody was hurt.
sentences.translation: Avariya bundan ham yomonroq **bo'lishi mumkin edi** — baxtimizga hech kim jarohatlanmadi.

sentences.text: Emma **could have stayed** at our flat instead of paying for a hotel.
sentences.translation: Emma mehmonxonaga pul to'lash o'rniga bizning kvartiramizda **qolsa bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: It was a great opportunity, and he **could have earned** twice as much.
sentences.translation: Bu ajoyib imkoniyat edi, u ikki baravar ko'p **pul topishi mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: That was dangerous! You **could have fallen** off the roof.
sentences.translation: Bu xavfli edi! Tomdan **yiqilib tushishing mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **could have caught** the earlier train, but he missed it by a minute.
sentences.translation: Bekzod oldingi poyezdga **ulgurishi mumkin edi**, lekin bir daqiqaga kechikdi.

sentences.text: Why didn't you ask for help? Any of us **could have checked** the figures for you.
sentences.translation: Nega yordam so'ramading? Raqamlarni har birimiz **tekshirib bersak bo'lardi**.

examples.title: Impossible: **couldn't have done**
examples.description: O'tmishda imkonsiz edi — couldn't have + V3: «-a olmagan bo'lardi», «-ishi mumkin emas edi». Minnatdorlik va maqtovda ko'p.

sentences.text: We **couldn't have finished** the project on time without your help.
sentences.translation: Sizning yordamingizsiz loyihani o'z vaqtida **tugata olmagan bo'lardik**.

sentences.text: The holiday was perfect — the weather **couldn't have been** better.
sentences.translation: Ta'til mukammal o'tdi — ob-havo bundan yaxshi **bo'lishi mumkin emas edi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **couldn't have taken** the money; he was in Samarkand that day.
sentences.translation: Jasur pulni **olgan bo'lishi mumkin emas**; u o'sha kuni Samarqandda edi.

sentences.text: I **couldn't have done** it alone, so thank you all very much.
sentences.translation: Buni yolg'iz **qila olmasdim**, shuning uchun barchangizga katta rahmat.

sentences.text: The timing **couldn't have been** worse — the shop closed just as we arrived.
sentences.translation: Vaqt bundan ham yomon **bo'lishi mumkin emas edi** — biz yetib kelganimizda do'kon yopildi.

sentences.text: Even the best doctor **couldn't have saved** the patient; the injuries were too serious.
sentences.translation: Hatto eng yaxshi shifokor ham bemorni **qutqara olmagan bo'lardi**; jarohatlar juda og'ir edi.

sentences.text: Nilufar **couldn't have known** about the meeting — nobody told her.
sentences.translation: Nilufar yig'ilish haqida **bilishi mumkin emas edi** — unga hech kim aytmagan.

sentences.text: Honestly, you **couldn't have chosen** a better present for my mother.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, onamga bundan yaxshiroq sovg'a **tanlay olmasdingiz**.

sentences.text: Our team played brilliantly; we **couldn't have asked** for a better final.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz ajoyib o'ynadi; bundan yaxshiroq finalni **orzu ham qila olmasdik**.

sentences.text: Without GPS, we **couldn't have found** the tiny village in the mountains.
sentences.translation: GPSsiz tog'dagi kichkina qishloqni **topa olmagan bo'lardik**.

examples.title: **could do** or **could have done**?
examples.description: Juft-juft: hozir yoki kelajakdagi imkoniyat (could + fe'l) va o'tmishdagi amalga oshmagan imkoniyat (could have + V3).

sentences.text: We **could visit** Khiva in the spring, when it isn't too hot.
sentences.translation: Bahorda, juda issiq bo'lmaganda, Xivaga **borsak bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: We **could have visited** Khiva last spring, but we were too busy.
sentences.translation: O'tgan bahorda Xivaga **borsak bo'lardi**, lekin juda band edik.

sentences.text: You **could ask** your manager for a pay rise this year.
sentences.translation: Bu yil menejeringdan maosh oshirishni **so'rasang bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: You **could have asked** for a pay rise when you got that big contract.
sentences.translation: O'sha katta shartnomani olganingda maosh oshirishni **so'rasang bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: It's very late, so Kate **could be** asleep already.
sentences.translation: Juda kech bo'ldi, Keyt allaqachon **uxlab qolgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: I'm glad Kate didn't drive in that storm; she **could have had** an accident.
sentences.translation: Keyt o'sha bo'ronda mashina haydamaganidan xursandman; u avariyaga **uchrashi mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: The fog **could cause** delays at the airport this morning.
sentences.translation: Tuman bugun ertalab aeroportda **kechikishlarga sabab bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The fog was so thick that the plane **could have crashed**.
sentences.translation: Tuman shunchalik quyuq ediki, samolyot **halokatga uchrashi mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **could become** a great lawyer one day — he loves arguing.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bir kun ajoyib advokat **bo'lishi mumkin** — u bahslashishni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: His grandfather **could have become** a famous artist, but the war changed everything.
sentences.translation: Bobosi mashhur rassom **bo'lishi mumkin edi**, lekin urush hammasini o'zgartirdi.

examples.title: Dialogue: after a missed flight
examples.description: Reysdan qolib ketgan ikki do'st: o'tmishdagi boy berilgan imkoniyatlar (could have), endi nima qilish mumkinligi (could) va «bundan ham yomon bo'lishi mumkin edi».

sentences.text: — I can't believe we missed the flight! We **could have left** home earlier.
sentences.translation: — Reysdan qolganimizga ishonolmayman! Uydan ertaroq **chiqsak bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: — I know, and you **could have checked** the traffic before we set off.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman, sen ham yo'lga chiqishdan oldin tirbandlikni **tekshirsang bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: — Well, you **could have reminded** me. Anyway, what can we do now?
sentences.translation: — Sen ham menga **eslatsang bo'lardi**. Nima bo'lganda ham, endi nima qilamiz?

sentences.text: — We **could take** the evening flight, if there are still seats.
sentences.translation: — Agar joy bo'lsa, kechki reysda **uchsak bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: — That **could be** expensive. Or we **could go** by train tomorrow.
sentences.translation: — Bu **qimmat bo'lishi mumkin**. Yoki ertaga poyezdda **ketsak bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: — The train **could take** twelve hours! I **couldn't sit** that long.
sentences.translation: — Poyezd o'n ikki soat **yurishi mumkin**! Men shuncha **o'tira olmasdim**.

sentences.text: — OK, let's ask at the desk. It **could have been** worse, you know.
sentences.translation: — Mayli, kassada so'raylik. Bundan ham yomonroq **bo'lishi mumkin edi**, bilasanmi.

sentences.text: — How? We **could have been** in Manchester by now!
sentences.translation: — Qanday qilib? Hozir Manchesterda **bo'lishimiz mumkin edi**!

sentences.text: — We **could have lost** our passports too. At least we've got those.
sentences.translation: — Pasportlarimizni ham **yo'qotib qo'yishimiz mumkin edi**. Hech bo'lmasa ular bor.

sentences.text: — True. And honestly, I **couldn't have found** a better travel partner.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri. Rostini aytsam, bundan yaxshiroq hamroh **topa olmasdim**.
